spots.name: Camp Hancock State Historic Site
spots.tip: A landmark with history. Low light brings out texture; check opening hours if it's fenced.

spots.name: Barren Butte
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 660 m (2,165 ft).
